name: Boadilla del Monte (Spain)
description: Vertically divided green and pale yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Boadilla del Monte (five holm oaks on yellow within a bordure of chain).
history: The arms of Boadilla del Monte were approved by royal decree on 6 October 1977; the flag, approved by agreement of 22 February 2007, is a rectangular cloth of proportions 2:3 divided vertically into two equal parts.

features.role: Boadilla del Monte arms — five holm oaks on yellow within a bordure of chain
